title: cuscuta epithymum subsp. triumvirati
intro: Cuscuta epithymum subsp. triumvirati, commonly known as Dodder, is a type of parasitic flowering plant that grows by attaching itself to other plants and drawing nutrients from them. The health benefits of Dodder include its potential to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial agent, which may help in reducing inflammation, fighting free radicals, and preventing infections. The therapeutic actions of Dodder include its ability to stimulate the immune system and improve cardiovascular health, as well as its potential to exhibit anti-cancer and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Dodder include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
